theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_lattice_chain_coeff
theorems.statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (β : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) N → ℝ) (Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) (m + 1)), 0 < ρ → IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc → ∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) N, β F ≠ 0 → latticeFace ρ F ⊆ Pc.support ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (|β F| * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ Pc.mass
